comparison.objective: Candidate removes four HELICOIL tangs; record caps three used batteries and places them in a recycling box.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires precision impact, safe withdrawal, search, and tiny-fragment pickup; record requires orienting and press-fitting terminal covers before object transfer.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires four fractures and all fragments in a tray with retained inserts undamaged; record requires every battery covered before box placement, with any bare battery invalid.
comparison.reason: Protective-cover installation and disposal test press-fitting and sequencing, not controlled fracture.
